rendered: Over the long-term test of more than 1000[1] plating/stripping cycles, the carbon/Al electrode maintained an average Coulombic efficiency of 99.8%[2] and a low average voltage hysteresis of 14 mV[3]. The paper states this as follows: "over 1000 plating-stripping cycles, an average[4] Coulombic efficiency of 99.8% is maintained with a low average[5] hysteresis of 14 mV[6]". The same values appear in the discussion of the long-term test: a highly stable hysteresis averaging 14 mV[7] and a Coulombic efficiency averaging 99.8%[8].
